source: LinkedIn Community Management / Marketing API (versioned REST, Linkedin-Version YYYYMM, default moniker 202607) - organizations + organizationsLookup, networkSizes, organizationalEntityShareStatistics, organizationPageStatistics, organizationalEntityFollowerStatistics, posts (rest/posts, replaces ugcPosts), socialMetadata (replaces socialActions)
note: no native BigQuery export - schema designed by us

tables.name: li_Organization
tables.grain: one row per organization per _DATA_DATE (daily snapshot of GET /rest/organizations/{id} + GET /rest/networkSizes/{urn}?edgeType=COMPANY_FOLLOWED_BY_MEMBER); PK (organization_id, _DATA_DATE); filter _DATA_DATE = _LATEST_DATE for current page state; metrics_follower_count is the only measure and is a point-in-time level, never a sum

tables.name: li_DailyStats
tables.grain: organization_id x segments_date (DAY granularity); one row assembled from three time-bound endpoints - organizationalEntityShareStatistics.totalShareStatistics, organizationPageStatistics.totalPageStatistics (views + clicks), organizationalEntityFollowerStatistics.followerGains; _DATA_DATE = segments_date; restated over a trailing re-pull window, MERGE on (organization_id, segments_date)

tables.name: li_FollowerStats
tables.grain: organization_id x segments_type x segments_value per _DATA_DATE; lifetime follower demographics from organizationalEntityFollowerStatistics called WITHOUT timeIntervals; segments_type in (SENIORITY, INDUSTRY, FUNCTION, STAFF_COUNT_RANGE, GEO, GEO_COUNTRY, ASSOCIATION_TYPE); each facet is capped at the top 100 values by LinkedIn; PK (organization_id, segments_type, segments_value, _DATA_DATE)

tables.name: li_Post
tables.grain: one row per post (urn:li:share:{id} or urn:li:ugcPost:{id}) per _DATA_DATE; post attributes from GET /rest/posts?q=author, lifetime-to-date statistics from organizationalEntityShareStatistics with shares=/ugcPosts=, reactions and comment counts from socialMetadata; PK (post_urn, _DATA_DATE); statistics are cumulative lifetime values as at _DATA_DATE, not daily deltas
